name: MERCOSUR Residence Agreement Residency

requirements.blocker_text: Under the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement (ratified by Paraguay as Ley 3565/08), nationals of member states (Argentina, Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay) and associated states (Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru) can obtain temporary residence in Paraguay with 'no requirement other than nationality' -- a valid passport, birth certificate, and negative criminal-record certificate. This gives an initial 2-year temporary residence, convertible to permanent status before it expires. Migraciones runs a dedicated MERCOSUR permanent-residency track separate from the general permanent-residency process, confirming this is treated as a distinct legal route domestically, not just an informal shortcut.
requirements.fix_path: Present a valid passport, birth certificate, and clean criminal record as a national of a MERCOSUR member or associated state to obtain temporary residence, then convert to permanent status before the 2-year period expires.

outcome.duration_length: 2 years temporary, convertible to permanent before expiry

GENUINE, SIGNIFICANT FINDING: this is arguably Paraguay's most consequential single route by volume -- it applies automatically to citizens of 4 other full member states and 4 associated states (effectively most of South America) with no other qualifying condition, a scale of automatic reciprocal access not seen elsewhere in this dataset. citizenship_after_months (60) modeled from the general naturalization framework, not a MERCOSUR-specific accelerated citizenship provision -- none was found.
